title: Menemen Eggplant Delight
description: A flavorful and nutritious recipe combining the rich taste of menemen with the tender eggplant for a delightful dish.
instructions: 2. Cut the eggplant into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
3. Brush both sides of the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
4. Place the eggplant slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Bake the eggplant for 20-25 minutes or until it is tender and lightly browned.
6. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
7. Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
9. Stir in the menemen (spicy tomato paste) and cook for 1-2 minutes.
10. Once the eggplant is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
11. Add the cooked eggplant slices to the skillet with the menemen mixture and toss to coat.
12. Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
